svg.title: Inventory
svg.desc: Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, C/C++. Front End: React, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind, Motion, PWA. Back End: FastAPI, Flask, PostgreSQL, Drizzle, SQLite, Firebase. Ai & Llms: Gemini API, Claude API, Groq API, LangGraph, Qdrant RAG, Prompting. Data & Ml: scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, OpenCV, Streamlit, BigQuery. Mobile: React Native, Expo Router, EAS Build, Reanimated, NFC. Edge: ESP32, PlatformIO, emlearn, LoRa, Raspberry Pi. Tools: Git, GitHub, Vercel, uv, Android Studio.
